provenance.tool: Sound Equalization and Correction System 2 (SECS 2) Beta 1.1.0, Speaker Gallery (DCinside), GPL-3.0
provenance.how: CorrectionEngine(...).compute() then secs.mimo.design_mimo(engine, fsiso, positions=[1, 2], f_low) run as a black box; only derived numbers are stored, no SECS code
provenance.configuration: positions = left ear, right ear of the aligned in-ear BRIRs (t0 = 0 for all, common time base); mains = all seven speakers, no subwoofers; MAIN_WEIGHT = MAIN_WEIGHT_LO = 1 (position 1 still drives the listening-position-only steps); SECS arrival delays set to zero after compute() (Impulcifer alignment already places the speakers); the minimum-position rule of design_mimo lowered from 3 to 2 positions for this run (private change, not distributed)

ir.construction: Hrir::open_recording_samples(estimator, fs, tracks, speakers, None, 2.0) for each file in that order, then crop_heads(1.0), align_ipsilateral_all(IPSILATERAL_PAIRS, 30.0), align_onset_groups_peak_leftref(None), crop_tails(estimator) (24000 samples each)

fields.supports: input -> support speaker -> 600 Hz FIR (support FIR convolved with the Fsiso low-pass, after the guard)
fields.level_db: support level relative to the correction filter energy
fields.ranges: support band (low, high) Hz or null
